content.title: DevFest 2023 Participation
content.summary: Participation in DevFest 2023 with workshops, networking, and exposure to the wider developer community.
content.body: 1–2 December 2023 · Google Developer Groups, Sonargaon. Engaged in workshops and networking with industry professionals, technology enthusiasts, and other developers.
